beta.notes:
# MisterZine Plex Core 0.1.0-beta.27.1

A stepping stone from beta.27: the 0.1.0-beta.28 app, worker, FFmpeg and
H.264 decoder core, packaged so that the updater installed with beta.27 can
install them. After it starts, Updates offers 0.1.0-beta.28 itself.

- Everything beta.28 brings is already in it; see the beta.28 notes for the
  new playback path, scrub previews, the playback looks and the supporter
  extras.
- Settings, sign-in and codes are kept. Rollback keeps the previous release.
- The output is chosen in the core's on-screen menu from now on.

# MisterZine Plex Core 0.1.0-beta.29

Updating from 0.1.0-beta.27 or earlier: Updates offers 0.1.0-beta.27.1 first,
the stepping stone the old updater can install; this release follows from
there.

A small release on top of 0.1.0-beta.28, which brought the H.264 decoder core
and the new playback path.

- The supporter code covers every current extra. **Playback UI theme** was
  asking for a code that does not exist; it now unlocks with the same code as
  the screensaver, the Home logo and the Random tab.

Rollback to the previous release still works and brings back its core.
Network seeking, server compatibility and different hardware setups remain
beta test areas.

Installers and update notices become available when this release and its
catalogue are published. See README.md for setup and feedback instructions.

memos.title: Welcome to beta 28 and up
memos.text: Beta 28 and up move the core to Ben Owen's new H.264 decoder. If the in-app update showed this as beta 27.1, the update automatically bumped you to beta 28 or newer. Thanks for testing! -Matija
